title: Quick Fried Croatian Peanut Fritters
description: Crispy and fatty Croatian fritters filled with peanuts, perfect for a brunch mood, and kosher friendly.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, salt, and sugar.
In a separate bowl, mix the peanut butter, eggs, and milk until smooth.
Add the chopped peanuts to the peanut butter mixture and stir until combined.
Gradually add the dry ingredients to the peanut butter mixture and mix until a dough forms.
Heat the vegetable oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees.
Using a spoon, drop small balls of the dough into the hot oil.
Fry the fritters for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
Remove the fritters from the oil and place on a paper towel lined plate to drain excess oil.
Serve the fritters warm and enjoy.
